            # Convert to time strings
            def to_time(minutes):
                h = minutes // 60
                m = minutes % 60
                return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}"
            start_time = to_time(meeting_start)
            end_time = to_time(meeting_end)
            print(f"{start_time}:{end_time} {day}")
            exit()
